artworks.title: La Place des Martyrs et la Taverne du Bagne
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, lift-ground aquatint, drypoint, roulette, and burnishing in brown-black on turpentine soaked paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a night scene in an urban environment. The image shows a crowded square or street with a large building displaying the sign "TAVERNE DU BAGNE" illuminated on its facade. Surrounding the building are various other structures depicted with dark shading to convey the nighttime setting. Several figures are gathered in front of the building, suggesting an event or gathering. The drawing includes trees with bare branches, implying a season other than summer. The image is bordered with detailed sketches and handwritten text, adding to a historical or storytelling element. The play of light and shadow creates a dramatic scene, emphasizing the urban landscape and the people present.

artworks.title: Les Noctambules (The Night Prowlers)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in black on beige laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a street scene with dogs and an archway. The image portrays a night-time setting with a cobblestone street, where the shadows of canine figures can be seen illuminated by light. The central figure is a large, shrouded silhouette. In the background, an archway opens into darkness. The use of lines and shadows contributes to a mood.

artworks.title: Woman at Toilette
artworks.medium: albumen silver print with applied color
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to image): 20.3 x 25.4 cm (8 x 10 in.)
page size: 35 x 48 cm (13 3/4 x 18 7/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ken and Kiyo Hitch in memory of Harry Lunn, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting on the floor in a room. She is wrapped in a garment, her shoulder is partially exposed. Her hair is styled in a bun with an accessory. She is looking at her reflection in a round mirror on a stand in front of her. She is wearing a light-colored checkered kimono. In front of her is a box with items and a teapot on a small stove. The floor has a woven texture and the backdrop is a plain curtain or wall.

artworks.title: Les Programmes du Théâtre Libre
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Cafritz Foundation in memory of Martin Atlas
artworks.description: The image shows an older man with distinctive facial features, long white hair and beard, standing inside a wooden structure. The man wears a dark brown jacket and striped pants, and is depicted reaching forward with his left hand while the right hand rests at his side. In the background, there is text in French in an ornate font that reads "Les Programmes du Théâtre Libre" and "Silhouette d’Antoine dans les Tisserands." The overall color scheme of the image is muted and earthy, with a cream-colored background.

artworks.title: L'Arlequin
artworks.medium: lithograph in black and red on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical cabaret program. The image features a harlequin figure dressed in a classic diamond-patterned costume, complete with a ruffled collar and mask, sitting on a wooden stool. The figure is depicted gesturing with one hand and smiling. The title "L'Arlequin" is prominently displayed at the top in bold, stylized letters. The text provides information about the location "3 Rue D'Arras" and includes the phrase "L'Arlequin Cabaret Artistique De La Rive Gauche." The word "PROGRAMME" is written vertically in red letters on the right side of the image. This is in the style of Toulouse-Lautrec, capturing the belle époque era's vibrant cabaret scene with its expressive line work and emphasis on theatrical promotion.

artworks.title: Ton Sang
artworks.medium: lithograph in gray on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Given in Memory of Martin Atlas by his Friends
artworks.description: The image displays an illustration with two figures embracing each other closely. The figures are depicted from the waist up, intertwined in a swirling movement with dynamic, curved lines surrounding them. Their facial features are gently rendered, with one figure having short dark hair and facing downward, while the other figure, with slightly longer and lighter hair, tilts their head upwards. The figures are dressed in simple, subtle-toned clothing that blends into the sketch's monochromatic style. There is no visible jewelry or objects held by the figures. The background merges into the composition with sweeping lines, contributing to the dreamlike ambiance of the scene. On the left side of the image, there is text in French detailing a theatrical performance titled "Ton Sang," with names of performance participants and the venue's address. The name "Henry Bataille" appears inscribed towards the bottom right of the illustration.

artworks.title: Père
artworks.medium: lithograph in green on japan paper (deluxe edition impression)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Cafritz Foundation in memory of Martin Atlas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical event announcement. The composition is a detailed poster highlighting a gala evening featuring a play by August Strindberg, with accompanying text in an ornamental, artistic style. The poster announces a theatrical performance and lists the distribution of roles alongside decorative elements. It includes illustrations of figures reading a book at a desk and possibly sleeping figures in the lower left corner, surrounded by swirling lines. The artistic lettering and the inclusion of both text and illustrative figures suggest an Art Nouveau influence.

artworks.title: Les Oeufs de Pâques
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [proof of early state without letters]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an oversized egg with bird hatchlings emerging from it. The drawing features a large, elliptical egg at the center, with the top cracked open to reveal a cluster of bird hatchlings. Surrounding the egg are various elements including an inkwell with a quill pen and illustrations on paper indicating a writing or artistic theme. The background contains faintly sketched scenes and flying birds.

artworks.title: Arches of the Larger Baths at Hadrian's Villa
artworks.medium: black chalk and white chalk with stumping on light brown laid paper, with later framing line in brown ink
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient ruin with arches and crumbling stonework surrounded by overgrown vegetation. The horizon is slightly elevated, emphasizing the towering remnants of the architecture. Expressive brushstrokes and textures are notable, especially in the vines and leaves on the stone. The color palette is subdued, mainly earthy tones and black, creating contrast and suggesting openings into the distance, enhancing the old, abandoned feel of the ruins.

artworks.title: March and April
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Paul Bril
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural landscape with figures engaging in agricultural activities such as pruning vines and tending plants. A bare tree dominates the left side, with figures working on a small hill to the left. In the center, a building sits on an incline leading into a wooded area. Animals are present. On the right, grand buildings are seen on a hill. A rainbow appears in the sky. The scene is rendered in crosshatched lines, portraying a detailed and textured appearance.

artworks.title: May and June
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Paul Bril
artworks.description: The image is a detailed engraving depicting a scene from an aerial view. It shows a landscape with a horizon in the middle distance, separating the sky with clouds and celestial symbols. On the left, there is a grand building surrounded by terraces with urns and figures. Some figures are strolling or conversing. In the foreground, people in period clothing are gathered for a performance or storytelling. Nearby, a person plays an instrument near a lion's head fountain. Further right, a boat with passengers and rowers navigates a river toward a building where additional figures are visible. The engraving is finely detailed, capturing textures of foliage, stone, and water. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of grayscale.

artworks.title: July and August
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Paul Bril
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with various activities in a rural setting. The perspective is elevated, offering a view of the landscape and activities below. In the foreground, people are resting under a tree, tending to horses, and walking along a path. Fields with working figures and haystacks extend into the distance. A town or fortress is visible on a cliff in the upper right, with the sky and clouds in the background. The artwork features intricate engravings showcasing texture and movement. It uses varying shades of gray and black, with illumination coming from the left to create shadows.

artworks.title: September and October
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Paul Bril
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural setting with people harvesting fruit, climbing ladders and sorting produce. In the background, there is a stone structure with large columns on a gentle incline. The horizon shows rolling hills and a distant castle or town. The details are captured with fine brushstrokes and etching technique, showing intricate textures. The color palette is black and white, emphasizing the linework and defining the texture and depth. The sky has birds in flight and a partially obscured moon, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: November and December
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Paul Bril
artworks.description: The image shows a busy rural scene divided into two labeled areas "November" and "December." The viewpoint is slightly elevated, providing a bird's-eye view. The scene includes a mix of buildings, fortifications, trees, animals, peasants, and a path leading to a distant town or city on a hill. The artwork features intricate brushstrokes, with detailed foliage and textures. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of grey and black. On the left side, there are pigs and peasants among leafless trees, while the right side depicts figures interacting with livestock and goats, with a path leading to the town.

artworks.title: Mademoiselle Fifi
artworks.description: The image features a vintage illustration with two upper-body depictions of individuals at a table. The person on the left has short, slicked-back light hair, wears glasses, and holds a cigarette. They are dressed in a dark jacket. The person on the right has short, curly dark hair and high cheekbones. She wears a bright yellow garment and holds a drink in her raised right arm. The table in front of them has a glass, a knife, and what looks like half a loaf of bread. The background is plain with text including "Le Théatre Libre" and "Mlle Fifi." Additional text mentions Guy de Maupassant and another individual related to the illustration.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within image): 8.7 x 10.9 cm (3 7/16 x 4 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an angel kneeling before a woman. Both are visible from head to toe. The angel is in a kneeling position with their body slightly turned to the side. They have curly hair and large wings opened behind them. The angel is dressed in a flowing robe with prominent folds, holding a staff in one hand and extending the other towards the woman. The woman is dressed in a long garment with a cape draped over her shoulders. Her hair is long and wavy, cascading over her shoulders. She stands with her hands resting on what appears to be the edge of a lectern or bookstand. Between them is a pot with lilies, and above her, a dove is surrounded by rays of light. The scene is detailed and set against a simple textured background.

artworks.title: The Banquet of Alexander the Great
artworks.artist: Domenico del Barbiere after Francesco Primaticcio
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in an architectural setting. The image depicts an interior with multiple figures seated and interacting in a semicircular arrangement, within a grand architectural setting featuring statues and reliefs. The scene is detailed, showcasing figures in classical attire, some engaged in conversation while others appear to be in contemplation or observation. The left side shows a curving wall with a doorway and niches filled with figures, while the background includes a detailed architectural backdrop, suggesting an emphasis on spatial depth and classical architectural elements. The figures in the drawing are engaged in varied activities, such as holding objects or interacting with each other. The style is reminiscent of classical or Renaissance art, emphasizing proportionate human figures and detailed architectural elements.

artworks.title: View of Saint-Andéol
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 27.2 x 36 cm (10 11/16 x 14 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene in an old village setting. The point of view is eye-level, capturing people and animals in the village. The horizon is low, obscured by tall structures like a textured tower and buildings, as well as trees reaching towards the sky. The artwork utilizes fine and detailed brushstrokes or etching lines, realistically depicting textures on walls, ground, and foliage. The color palette consists of various shades of sepia or warm brown. In the foreground, goats are resting on the ground, and a man with a pack animal appears to be getting ready to move. Villagers are seen sitting or standing around a rustic fountain. Tall trees surround the scene, and the sky features light strokes representing drifting clouds.

artworks.title: Oboe Player
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and roulette touched with gray wash on laid paper [proof]
artworks.description: The image features an etching of three humans and a lamb. The individuals are depicted in the upper bodies. On the left, an older man plays a wind instrument, facing right. In the center, a younger person with long hair wears a large hat and heavy clothing. On the right, another young individual holds a sheep by its legs. In the foreground, there is a basket with a lamb and a wooden table. The background has a dark, textured pattern.

artworks.title: Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved illustration of a woman seated on stone steps or blocks. She is dressed in flowing robes with a head covering. Beside her is a man with a beard and long hair, possibly holding a small figure. A goat or sheep is near them. The background features classical architecture, columns, a statue, and lush foliage with palm trees.

artworks.title: The Penitent Magdalene
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within platemark): 18.2 x 14.3 cm (7 3/16 x 5 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body view of a person turned towards the right, with their head slightly bowed forward and their right hand placed over their chest. The person has long, flowing hair and is wearing draped clothing resembling robes. Surrounding the person are a cherub in the upper left, a crucifix with a figure to the right, a skull, foliage, and an intricately patterned background creating a radiant halo effect around the person's head.

artworks.title: Begraef-plaets der Joden, buyten Amsteldam (Jewish Cemetery outside Amsterdam)
artworks.artist: Abraham Blooteling after Jacob van Ruisdael
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an elevated point of view, featuring a cemetery in a wooded area. A church steeple rises above the treetops in the distance. The scene is depicted in a monochrome etching style with detailed line work and cross-hatching, creating a textured appearance. Gravestones and tomb memorials of various shapes and sizes are seen, with lush foliage surrounding the cemetery. The sky is subtly shaded with scattered clouds, and the color palette is primarily sepia tones.

artworks.title: The Penitent Magdalene
artworks.artist: Attributed to Domenico Falcini after Francesco Villamena after Francesco Vanni
artworks.dimensions: overall (cut to platemark): 18.5 x 14.2 cm (7 5/16 x 5 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a female figure seated in profile, facing left. She has long, wavy hair that flows past her shoulders and delicate facial features with pronounced eyebrows and a contemplative expression. She is draped in a loosely fitting garment with flowing sleeves, revealing her bare shoulder. She holds an open book or scroll in her right hand, resting on her lap, while her left hand is placed on her chest. Next to her, an angelic child with wings offers a small pot toward her shoulder. Beams of light radiate around her head, suggesting a halo. The background features a crucifix with a plaque marked 'INRI,' surrounded by foliage, a skull, and a tree branch intruding from the upper left corner. The image has a textured, etched quality capturing fine detail.

artworks.title: Two Seated Bathers (Deux baigneuses assises)
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on brown wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures seated on the ground. The image depicts two simplified, abstracted figures against a heavily black background. The figures have rounded, flowing lines and are portrayed in various seated positions. One figure appears to be facing the viewer slightly, with its legs aligned, while the other figure seems more reclined with its back slightly turned to the viewer. The outlines are bold, and any interior detail is minimal or absent. The signature "FV" is located at the bottom left corner.
